records.title: Model partitioning and batch scheduling: Leveraging local resources for cost-efficient device-cloud collaborative serverless inference
records.reason: Primary ScienceDirect page returned HTTP 403 when opened; DOI URL also inaccessible. Search output exposed publisher abstract only, not the full article. Device-cloud partitioning and batch scheduling are plausibly relevant, but methods/evaluation could not be reviewed.

records.title: Full-spectrum prompt tuning with sparse MoE for open-set recognition
records.reason: Primary PubMed record supplies an abstract describing sparse MoE prompt tuning for vision-language open-set recognition, but no full-text article was available from the record; full-text access through Elsevier was not obtained. The MoE lineage is plausible but applicability to LLM inference is unresolved.

records.title: Circuits to Systems: Codesigning Efficient AI Hardware
records.reason: The IEEE publisher full text was not retrievable through the available page; accessible author/institutional metadata and abstract discuss broad AI hardware co-design, not an inspected full paper. The offload/hardware lineage keeps it plausible, but detailed LLM efficiency evidence is unavailable.

records.title: Beyond URLs: Metadata Diversity and Position for Efficient LLM Pretraining
records.reason: The paper studies metadata diversity and position in LLM pretraining inputs and measures downstream pretraining behavior; it changes data composition/order, not decoding, serving, KV-cache, or inference resource use. Its linked KV-cache relation is weak and the evidence does not connect the method to inference systems.

records.title: DualGazeNet: A Biologically Inspired Dual-Gaze Query Network for Salient Object Detection
records.reason: The work is salient-object detection and has no LLM inference contribution.
